prompt:
I have a simple static HTML page at `app/index.html`. Please write a Playwright script called `test_page.py` that opens the page using a `file://` URL, waits for it to load, and checks the following things:
1. The page title is exactly 'My Test App'
2. There is an `<h1>` element with the text 'Welcome to My Test App'
3. There is a button with the text 'Click Me'
4. Clicking the button changes the text of an element with id `status` to 'Button was clicked!'

After running the checks, print a JSON summary to stdout with the structure:
{"title_check": true/false, "h1_check": true/false, "button_exists": true/false, "click_check": true/false}

Make sure the script can be run directly with `python test_page.py`.
